column1: # Verdicts for the groups port/tools/inventory.py reports, keyed by "file enclosing-function".
# Columns: key, verdict, note. Read by: inventory.py --markdown --verdicts port/tools/inventory-verdicts.tsv
# added: delete (M1.2). replaced: restore (M1.3 to M1.5), the note gives the evidence. open: marked BF_RECOVER_OPEN in the source.

column3: The single-player battle, field and menu code.
The blacksmith shop and smithing mini-game.
Resting, day count and the travel map.
Save slots and the ending.
The block-puzzle mini-game.
Its class.
Externs of single-player globals. `HP_ST_SLEEP = 10` duplicates the online state `ST_SLEEP = 10` (GameActor.h); the constant goes and its use takes `ST_SLEEP`.
The `m_gid == 3` branch turns the single-player boy to face the field after a move; the `else` (`SetState(ST_STAND)`) is the online path and stays.
`SetState(HP_ST_SLEEP)` becomes `SetState(ST_SLEEP)`: same value, the online name (`ST_SLEEP = 10`, GameActor.h).
Externs and definitions of single-player globals and the damage queue (`g_DM_List`, `g_DamageMoment`).

Lines 608-633 are the single-player set-up: player placed at cell 13,0, starter items, the two companions, story state, skill 0x107, screen 100, damage queue reset, two instruction lines. Online, the player is placed from `g_session.m_posX/Y` in `CWorld::OnEnterFrame` and items, skills and status arrive by packet. `g_BackTexture` is set here and read nowhere. The 2008 client (`CGameMode::Initialize`, 0x57A970) ends after the weather set-up with `m_homunGID = m_homunAlive = 0; InitHomunTargetInfo(); m_merGID = m_merAlive = 0; InitMerTargetInfo();` (session offsets 0x7C3A20/0x7C3AB0/0x7C3AC8/0x7C3B54, the helpers at 0x669DF0/0x669E50 reset six fields each, as the source helpers do); restored.

`ProcessDamageSituation()`, `RenderBackGround2D()` and `RenderMenu()` are single-player. Reference 0x57BC90: `CheckSystemMessage(); PollNetworkStatus();` at the top (restored; `PollNetworkStatus` existed and nothing called it), and inside `if (g_isSkipFrame > 0)` the CZ_REQUEST_TIME every 12 000 ms, i.e. `SynchronizeTimeWithServer(false)` inlined, before `ProcessAssignAID` and the cache unload (restored; the source synchronised only once, so the zone server got no keep-alive). Open (`onupdate-calls`): the reference calls five functions where the source calls `ProcessInput` and `ProcessPlayWave`, and more in its drawing part.
The `m_lastPcGid == 1` block queues single-player skills on clicks on the acolyte; `ProcessPcPick` after it is the online path.

The whole body steers the single-player battle. Restored from the 2008 client (0x587C00, called from `ProcessInput` 0x588CC0 with the window manager's result): nothing while a skill is aimed (`m_skillUseInfo.m_skillUseType`, this+0x3B4); with DA_DREAM learned it counts `m_MouseRollCount/m_MouseRollMax`; Shift+wheel tilts the camera by 5 degrees with the `ProcessRBtn` limits; over a window it does nothing unless Ctrl is held; with /q2 (`m_isQuickSpell2`) it fires the shortcut bar (`UM_USE_SHORTEN_ITEM` 6/7) and sets `m_isQ2begin`; otherwise it zooms by 24.3 between `CLOSE_DIST` and `AVG_DIST`/`FAR_DIST` (or the map's view point), with three times the distance for a sitting Star Gladiator without SG_DEVIL.
Plays the queue of damage the single-player battle computes locally; online, damage arrives as `ZC_NOTIFY_ACT` and is shown by the actor messages.

Client-side experience and level-up of the single-player acolyte; online, `ZC_LONGPAR_CHANGE`/`ZC_PAR_CHANGE` carry them. `GetNextExpValue` and `GetWeaponPower` serve only it and the single-player status display and go with it.
Used only by the shop of `HP_BuySell.cpp`.
Called only by the single-player code (closure rule); dead once it goes.
Declarations of the above.
Externs of single-player globals.
Spawns the single-player companions locally (no packet: an int id and two shorts); online actors enter with `ZC_NOTIFY_STANDENTRY` and friends.
Spawns the single-player monsters locally.
A copy of the broadcast balloon fed with single-player text instead of a packet; `Zc_Broadcast` is the online handler.
Used only by the single-player battle.
Used only by the single-player battle.
Declarations of the above.
Draws the single-player 2D backgrounds; called only from `HP_Battle.cpp`/`HP_RestTravell.cpp`.
Declaration of the above.
Externs of single-player globals.

The block on actor 1 (weapon and headgear sprites, `SetStatusData`) dresses the single-player acolyte; online the server sends `ZC_SPRITE_CHANGE` and the status packets after the equip ack. `SetStatusData` serves only the single-player code and goes with it.
The same block for taking off.
Creates inventory items locally.
The smithing reward.
Equip location table for `HP_AddItem`.
Monster skill choice of the single-player battle.
Local equip.
Used only by `GainExp`.
Declarations of the above and `m_DayCount`.
Extern of the damage queue.
Fills the damage queue.

The single-player version draws only ATK (`Str*10 + weapon power`) and DEF (`Vit*5`) of actor 1. Restored from the 2008 client (0x476C10): the stat costs right-aligned at x 114, then `%d + %d` ATK/refine, `%d ~ %d` MATK, HIT, CRI at x 192 and DEF, MDEF, FLEE as `%d + %d`, ASPD as `(2000 - m_ASPD) / 10`, status points and the guild name at x 273, rows 21 to 101. The session getters it needs were declared without bodies; they become inline accessors (the reference reads the members directly).
Externs and definitions of single-player globals.

Tetris moves and `g_menuSelect` in the arrow keys, `ExeMenu()` on A, `SetcurScreen` on D, the no-op `GetGameActorByAid(1)` on S. Also, found by reading: the key remapping at the top (Enter, scan codes 0x1e/0x20/0x11/0x2d, W, X turned into A/D/up/down) is single-player; it makes the online `VK_RETURN`, Alt+X and Alt+W cases unreachable, which shows it was put in front of them.
`HIGHPRIEST.EXE` added to the list of accepted process names.
The same.

`data_hp.grf` and the `g_serviceType` test: the archive list is read from `DATA.INI` before the first file is opened (M1.3). `Setup_HP.exe` loop: built-in defaults (M1.5). `g_Aco_Name` and the HP/SP/level/zeny set-up: single-player session, deleted. `MT_GAME, "World_HP.rsw"`: `MT_LOGIN, "login.rsw"`, as the 2008 `WinMain` (0x697D70) ends in `Run(0, "login.rsw")` (M1.3). The process-name check goes (M1.5).
Type of the damage queue.
Type of the travel map.
Registry key and window title name HighPriest; the 2008 client (0x50F7C0) has `Software\Gravity Soft\Ragnarok` and `Ragnarok`. Made neutral: `Software\` + `BF_APP_NAME` and `BF_APP_NAME` (M1.5).
Externs of single-player globals.

Draws `win_make_HP.bmp`, a second (blacksmith) preview and the difficulty marker. Restored from the 2008 client (0x462920): `win_make.bmp`, `DrawHexagon()` (defined and never called), the one preview. The stat values are six `UIStaticText` that `OnCreate` (0x4625A0) makes at x 489, y 42 + 16i and `InitTextControls` (0x4633F0, emptied here) fills.

OK set up the single-player save, Cancel went to a single-player screen. Restored from the 2008 client (0x463500): OK stores the character in `g_charInfo`, sends `LMM_SENDCHARINFO` (handled in `CLoginMode::SendMsg` and sent by nobody, which then sends `CH_MAKE_CHAR`) and closes; every OK also stores the name and the eight parameters in the login mode (`LMM_SET_MAKING_CHAR_NAME`, `LMM_SET_CHAR_PARAM`: Str..Luk, head palette, head), which the constructor reads back (`LMM_GET_CHAR_PARAM`; `CLoginMode` initialises them to 5,5,5,5,5,5,0,1); Cancel closes and sends `MM_COMMAND, LMM_SELECTCHARACTER`; each stat button refreshes the texts. The difficulty button and the second preview with its head buttons go (`MakeButton` 0x462BF0 makes the eight buttons the source made two of, and the three head buttons). Not restored: the reference refuses names containing `gravity` or starting `[gm`.
The 45 single-player methods of `UIWindowMgr`.
The five units leave the list of game units (read by `census.sh` and by the Windows `Makefile`, which is left as it is; the branch gives up the byte-identical build).
